{"sql": "WITH q AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-04-01' THEN 'Q1'
              WHEN o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-04-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-07-01' THEN 'Q2' END AS quarter,
         i.price
  FROM orders o JOIN order_items i USING(order_id)
  WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled','unavailable')
    AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-07-01'
), agg AS (
  SELECT quarter, sum(price) AS gmv FROM q GROUP BY quarter
)
SELECT
  max(gmv) FILTER (WHERE quarter='Q1') AS q1_gmv,
  max(gmv) FILTER (WHERE quarter='Q2') AS q2_gmv,
  round(100.0*(max(gmv) FILTER (WHERE quarter='Q2') - max(gmv) FILTER (WHERE quarter='Q1'))/nullif(max(gmv) FILTER (WHERE quarter='Q1'),0), 2) AS change_pct
FROM agg;"}

function.arguments:
{"sql": "WITH q AS (
  SELECT p.product_category_name AS cat,
         CASE WHEN o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-04-01' THEN 'Q1'
              WHEN o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-04-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-07-01' THEN 'Q2' END AS qtr,
         SUM(oi.price) AS gmv
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled','unavailable')
    AND p.product_category_name IS NOT NULL
    AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-07-01'
  GROUP BY 1,2
), piv AS (
  SELECT cat,
         SUM(CASE WHEN qtr='Q1' THEN gmv END) AS gmv_q1,
         SUM(CASE WHEN qtr='Q2' THEN gmv END) AS gmv_q2
  FROM q GROUP BY cat
), both AS (
  SELECT cat, gmv_q1, gmv_q2, gmv_q2 - gmv_q1 AS diff
  FROM piv WHERE gmv_q1 IS NOT NULL AND gmv_q2 IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE diff < 0) AS declining_categories,
       COUNT(*) AS compared_categories,
       (SELECT cat FROM both WHERE diff < 0 ORDER BY diff ASC LIMIT 1) AS largest_drop_category,
       (SELECT diff FROM both WHERE diff < 0 ORDER BY diff ASC LIMIT 1) AS largest_drop_amount
FROM both;"}

{"sql": "WITH q AS (
  SELECT p.product_category_name AS cat,
         CASE WHEN o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-04-01' THEN 'Q1'
              WHEN o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-04-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-07-01' THEN 'Q2' END AS qtr,
         SUM(oi.price) AS gmv,
         COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orders,
         COUNT(*) AS items
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled','unavailable')

    AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-07-01'
  GROUP BY 1,2
), piv AS (
  SELECT cat,
         SUM(CASE WHEN qtr='Q1' THEN gmv END) AS gmv_q1,
         SUM(CASE WHEN qtr='Q2' THEN gmv END) AS gmv_q2,
         SUM(CASE WHEN qtr='Q1' THEN orders END) AS orders_q1,
         SUM(CASE WHEN qtr='Q2' THEN orders END) AS orders_q2,
         SUM(CASE WHEN qtr='Q1' THEN items END) AS items_q1,
         SUM(CASE WHEN qtr='Q2' THEN items END) AS items_q2
  FROM q GROUP BY cat
)
SELECT cat, gmv_q1, gmv_q2, gmv_q2 - gmv_q1 AS diff,
       orders_q1, orders_q2, items_q1, items_q2,
       ROUND(gmv_q1/NULLIF(orders_q1,0),2) AS aov_q1,
       ROUND(gmv_q2/NULLIF(orders_q2,0),2) AS aov_q2
FROM piv
WHERE gmv_q1 IS NOT NULL AND gmv_q2 IS NOT NULL AND gmv_q2 < gmv_q1
ORDER BY diff ASC
LIMIT 10;"}

{"sql": "WITH b AS (
  SELECT c.customer_state AS state,
         count(DISTINCT c.customer_unique_id) AS buyers
  FROM orders o
  JOIN customers c USING(customer_id)
  WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-04-01'
    AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-07-01'
    AND c.customer_state IN ('SP','RJ')
  GROUP BY c.customer_state
), g AS (
  SELECT c.customer_state AS state,
         sum(i.price) AS gmv
  FROM orders o
  JOIN customers c USING(customer_id)
  JOIN order_items i USING(order_id)
  WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-04-01'
    AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-07-01'
    AND o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled','unavailable')
    AND c.customer_state IN ('SP','RJ')
  GROUP BY c.customer_state
)
SELECT b.state, b.buyers, g.gmv,
       round(g.gmv / b.buyers, 2) AS gmv_per_buyer
FROM b JOIN g USING(state)
ORDER BY b.state;"}

function.arguments:
{"sql": "WITH b AS (
  SELECT c.customer_state AS state, count(DISTINCT c.customer_unique_id) AS buyers
  FROM orders o JOIN customers c USING(customer_id)
  WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-04-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-07-01'
    AND c.customer_state IN ('SP','RJ')
  GROUP BY c.customer_state
), g AS (
  SELECT c.customer_state AS state, sum(i.price) AS gmv
  FROM orders o JOIN customers c USING(customer_id) JOIN order_items i USING(order_id)
  WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-04-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-07-01'
    AND o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled','unavailable')
    AND c.customer_state IN ('SP','RJ')
  GROUP BY c.customer_state
)
SELECT
  max(CASE WHEN b.state='SP' THEN b.buyers END) AS sp_buyers,
  max(CASE WHEN b.state='RJ' THEN b.buyers END) AS rj_buyers,
  max(CASE WHEN g.state='SP' THEN g.gmv END) AS sp_gmv,
  max(CASE WHEN g.state='RJ' THEN g.gmv END) AS rj_gmv,
  round(max(CASE WHEN b.state='SP' THEN b.buyers END)::numeric / max(CASE WHEN b.state='RJ' THEN b.buyers END), 2) AS buyers_ratio_sp_rj,
  round(max(CASE WHEN g.state='SP' THEN g.gmv END) / max(CASE WHEN g.state='RJ' THEN g.gmv END), 2) AS gmv_ratio_sp_rj,
  round(max(CASE WHEN g.state='SP' THEN g.gmv END) - max(CASE WHEN g.state='RJ' THEN g.gmv END), 2) AS gmv_diff_sp_minus_rj,
  round(max(CASE WHEN b.state='SP' THEN b.buyers END) - max(CASE WHEN b.state='RJ' THEN b.buyers END), 0) AS buyers_diff_sp_minus_rj,
  round(max(CASE WHEN g.state='SP' THEN g.gmv END)/max(CASE WHEN b.state='SP' THEN b.buyers END), 2) AS sp_gmv_per_buyer,
  round(max(CASE WHEN g.state='RJ' THEN g.gmv END)/max(CASE WHEN b.state='RJ' THEN b.buyers END), 2) AS rj_gmv_per_buyer

  WHERE q2.order_status NOT IN ('canceled','unavailable')
  GROUP BY i.order_id
),
pay_agg AS (
  SELECT p.order_id, sum(p.payment_value) AS pay_amt
  FROM q2 JOIN order_payments p USING(order_id)
  WHERE q2.order_status NOT IN ('canceled','unavailable')
  GROUP BY p.order_id
)

  count(*) AS orders_compared,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE round(pay_amt,2) <> round(item_amt + freight_amt,2)) AS orders_pay_ne_item_plus_freight,
  round(sum(pay_amt - (item_amt + freight_amt)),2) AS total_gap,
  round(max(abs(pay_amt - (item_amt + freight_amt))),2) AS max_abs_gap
FROM item_agg JOIN pay_agg USING(order_id);"}

2018 年 Q2（按 order_purchase_timestamp 落在 2018-04-01 至 2018-06-30 之间，含全部订单状态）：

- 评价记录数 review_rows = 19889（评价表行数，一单可有多条）

用评价记录数当已评价订单数会怎样：
- 会高估 26 单（review_rows - reviewed_orders = 26），相对已评价订单数高估 0.1309%。
- 评价覆盖率会被虚高：真实覆盖率 99.4194%（19863/19979），用评价行数算则变成 99.5495%（19889/19979）。
- 原因：order_reviews 中 review_id 不保证唯一、一个订单可能有多条评价记录，行数不等于订单数；因此凡是"多少单获得评价"这类口径必须按订单去重（COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) 或 EXISTS 语义），不能用评价行数替代。本例偏差虽小（26 单），但方向性错误固定为高估，且在其他时间窗/卖家维度上偏差可能放大。
